name: isaac-mods
description: Eight Claude Code mods: progress and subagent panel, tool skins, a second reader, file tree, cache cost guard, destructive-command guard, feedback-to-rules, and a text browser.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar above the prompt plus an Agents side panel with a pixel crab, model, effort, tokens and cost per subagent.

plugins.name: tool-skins
plugins.description: Per-tool icons and theme colors for tool calls; seven themes, switch with /skin.

plugins.name: you-should-know
plugins.description: A side agent flags what you should not miss in long replies.

plugins.name: file-tree
plugins.description: A file panel showing what Claude reads, edits and commits.

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: Warns before a prompt reloads a cold prompt cache; /keepwarm keeps it warm.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Stops destructive shell commands and lists the files they would remove until you proceed.

plugins.name: reflect
plugins.description: Offers to save your corrections as rules in CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: A text-mode browser pane: /browse a URL, PR or local file.
